🚀 AutoMagik | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automate the launching of specific sets of applications on a Linux system based on user-defined profiles, thereby streamlining workflows for different tasks.
✨ Key Features: • Create autostart profiles for Linux • Select profiles to launch specific program lists • Personal utility for task-specific program startup • Tested on Fedora 44 KDE
📖 Summary: AutoMagik is a Python application designed to simplify the creation and management of autostart profiles on Linux systems. It allows users to select predefined profiles, each configured to launch a specific list of programs for a particular task, streamlining the startup process for various workflows.
